messages.author: e84a25a6575d417b
messages.subject: Error building the RJSONIO package
parts:
I'm having trouble deploying this app. I get this error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 16441...
Waiting for task: 723313
  building: Processing Bundle Id: 35114
  building: Building image: 34239
  building: Installing package: RColorBrewer (1.0-5)
  building: Installing package: xtable (1.7-3)
  building: Installing package: htmltools (0.2.4)
  building: Installing package: Rcpp (0.11.2)
  error: Building package: RJSONIO (1.2-0.2)
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
[2014-07-28T18:24:51.094253125+0000] Installing R package: digest (0.6.4)
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *binary* package ‘digest’ ...
* DONE (digest)
[2014-07-28T18:24:52.085116185+0000] Installing R package: RColorBrewer (1.0-5)
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *binary* package ‘RColorBrewer’ ...
* DONE (RColorBrewer)
[2014-07-28T18:24:53.110691249+0000] Installing R package: xtable (1.7-3)
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *binary* package ‘xtable’ ...
* DONE (xtable)
[2014-07-28T18:24:54.189221009+0000] Installing R package: htmltools (0.2.4)
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *binary* package ‘htmltools’ ...
* DONE (htmltools)
[2014-07-28T18:24:55.305541572+0000] Installing R package: Rcpp (0.11.2)
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *binary* package ‘Rcpp’ ...
* DONE (Rcpp)
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 723314 failed: Error building image: Error fetching RJSONIO (1.2-0.2) source. Error downloading package source: HTTP 404: Not Found
Execution halted

Weird thing is, I just embedded this same app inside an R Markdown file, and it deployed fine (code here and deployed here). I've updated JSONIO, shiny, and shinyapps packages and I'm using R 3.1.0 on Windows XP.

Best,

Nathan

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Error building the RJSONIO package
parts:
Nathan,

Did you try deploying your app again after your R Markdown was successful? I just deployed an app using the same version of RJSONIO package, and it was successful. I am thinking may be there was a temporary connection issue that caused your error?

Fereshteh
